name: T2 full normalized-feature anchor with unchanged centered head learning
purpose: Old-response preservation covers at most nine old-class contrast directions in T2, not the full768-dimensional feature. Frozen encoder improved old classes but hurt new classes. Test a soft full-feature target as a distinct mainline mechanism; not a strength sweep or claimed new distillation algorithm.
previous_result: Old-response gate failed old/overall gains; hard old-head complement qualified but centered old+2.1333/new-5.9333/overall-1.9pp vs old_response, so reject its T3 continuation. scientific_change: Replace centered old-logit MSE by scale^2*mean_B,D((normalize(studentCLS)-normalize(frozenTeacherCLS))^2), scale16 unchanged and coefficient1 fixed. This equals expected squared logit change along an isotropically random unit head (no actual random heads sampled). Full-rank in feature coordinates, invariant to common orthogonal feature basis rotations; no old-head projection or head constraint. B CE current-only, head centered-all-seen CE on detached student features, old head frozen, original RegMean unchanged. Do not claim the penalty strength matches old-logit MSE on this nonisotropic data.
teacher: Copy the exact shared T2 model into a frozen eval-mode teacher. Retain the task-start client model in memory; no extra teacher model transmission or disk duplicate is required in this simulator. Teacher is used during training only and discarded at inference; additional full encoder forward on every current image is charged. All teacher tensors must exactly match source at completion.
